analysis.primaryGoal: Drive final orders before the campaign ends by leveraging urgency and mystery bonus offers.
analysis.audience: Westpack business customers (likely B2B, as orders are in thousands of kroner and terms mention business use only).
analysis.offer: Mystery Box gift added to orders exceeding 1500, 3000, or 6000 DKK, with greater value at higher tiers. Countdown timer triggers end of offer.
products: Gift packaging products (implied by imagery and company line 'when packaging matters')

visualStyle.mood: Festive, urgent, playful with a business tone
layoutPatterns: Prominent mystery/hero image with question mark overlay
visualStyle.imageStyle: Product photos in a gift-box setting, overlaid with graphic question marks and festive patterns

copyStyle.tone: Conversational, playful, and urgent (references to elves in crisis and direct calls to act)
structure: Details of offer and rewards tiers
copyStyle.urgency: High—countdown timer, repeated 'last chance', final warning language

reusablePatterns: Mystery gift with tiered reward system based on purchase value
Storytelling (thematic narrative tied to seasonal or campaign premise)
Prominent call-to-action button immediately after key offer
FAQs or explanatory section about the mystery offer
Legally required notice/disclaimer at footer for business terms
risks: Mystery offers can generate disappointment if actual gifts underwhelm
Urgent messaging can lead to list fatigue if overused
Terms must be strictly followed to prevent customer frustration or legal issues

confidence.notes: Small text is generally legible except for some fine print below product images. Headings, CTAs, and main narrative are clearly readable.
